Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Past Project Experience Commercial Experience Criteria for Service Contracts: For experience, the single work executed by the bidder, as main or subcontractor, during any of the last

five years ending on last day of the month immediately previous to the month in which the last date of bid submission (in case of extended bid submission date, original bid submission date shall be considered) falls should be considered as detailed below: (a) Three similar successfully completed works Electrical manpower each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 729690 . OR (b) Two similar successfully completed works Electrical manpower each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 912112 . OR (c) One similar successfully completed work Electrical manpower costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 1459380 . Single/ Two/ Three Completed work order value as indicated above should be exclusive of GST. 4. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a.
